## ONE_LINE_SUMMARY
DeFi-first intelligence for autonomous Solana agents: Meteora DLMM brief + pool detail (verdict/risk/momentum), Solana DEX brief, DefiLlama DEX scout — plus secondary marketplace price tools for procurement. MCP Streamable HTTP at https://agentshare.dev/mcp plus REST /api/v1/*. Not a consumer storefront.

## PRIMARY_DISCOVERY_FETCH_ORDER
1. https://agentshare.dev/agent.json
2. https://agentshare.dev/.well-known/x402 — x402 seller discovery (endpoints, dual-auth, live prices)
3. https://agentshare.dev/.well-known/discovery.json
4. https://agentshare.dev/for-agents — use Accept: application/json (no text/html) for compact JSON kind agentshare_for_agents_discovery
5. https://agentshare.dev/api/v1/examples?template=managed-agent — Gemini Managed Agents / Antigravity MCP JSON template
6. https://agentshare.dev/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json — static MCP tool schemas (11 tools on public catalog)
7. https://agentshare.dev/openapi.json
8. https://agentshare.dev/pricing — agent-first: x402 pay-per-request primary; monthly API-key plans secondary

## MCP_TOOLS (eleven — public catalog)
| tool_name | use_when | rest_upstream |
| search_products | compare multiple listings | GET /api/v1/search |
| best_offer | one cheapest in-stock offer | GET /api/v1/offers/best |
| best_offer_under_budget | budget cap / under $X | GET /api/v1/offers/best-under-budget |
| product_detail | have product_id from search | GET /api/v1/products/{id} |
| commerce_quote | ACP / autonomous buyer envelope agentshare.price.v1 | POST /api/v1/agent/commerce/quote |
| service_meta | capabilities, limits, sources | GET /api/v1/meta |
| dex_overview | rank DEX protocols by volume | GET /api/v1/dex/overview |
| dex_top_movers | DEX volume change movers | GET /api/v1/dex/top-movers |
| solana_dex_brief | Solana DEX ecosystem brief | GET /api/v1/agent/defi/solana/brief |
| meteora_brief | Meteora DLMM pool brief (verdict, risk) — #1 hot path; x402 dynamic $0.01–$0.30 | POST /api/v1/agent/defi/meteora/brief |
| meteora_pool_detail | Meteora DLMM pool detail (bin depth, curve proxy, price) | POST /api/v1/agent/defi/meteora/pool-detail |

## NOT_ON_PUBLIC_MCP
Polymarket tools (polymarket_markets, polymarket_market_detail, polymarket_top_movers, polymarket_brief) are disabled on the public MCP catalog and anonymous discovery — legal review for Vietnam.

## MIEN_TRU_TRACH_NHIEM (VN)
- Chỉ cung cấp dữ liệu/phân tích tham khảo. Không phải lời khuyên đầu tư/giao dịch.
- Người dùng/agent tự chịu trách nhiệm cho mọi quyết định và hành động on-chain.
- Lưu ý về Việt Nam: sản phẩm không nhắm tới người dùng tại Việt Nam. Nếu vẫn truy cập từ Việt Nam (kể cả qua VPN), bạn tự chịu hoàn toàn trách nhiệm pháp lý theo quy định địa phương.

## AUTHENTICATION (dual-auth — prefer x402 for autonomous agents)
- mode_a_api_key: X-API-Key: agshp_... OR Authorization: Bearer agshp_...
- mode_b_x402: no key → gated REST returns HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (USDC via Circle Gateway)
- discovery: GET https://agentshare.dev/.well-known/x402
- pricing_page: https://agentshare.dev/pricing (x402 pay-per-request is primary; monthly plans secondary)
- register_api_key: POST https://agentshare.dev/api/v1/auth/register body {"email","password"}
- free_tier_api_key: ~100 requests/month (secondary human option)
- free_paths: marketing/docs/discovery/onboarding stay free (/, /docs, /agent.json, /api/v1/protocol, /.well-known/*, …)
- agent_json_field: x402_agent_instructions (same text as below — do not invent a flow)

## X402_AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS (verbatim — follow exactly)
This platform is agent-first and monetized with HTTP 402 (x402). If you receive HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header: (1) Base64-decode PAYMENT-REQUIRED (JSON with x402Version, resource, accepts[]). (2) Pay the listed USDC amount via Circle Gateway on the stated network (pilot: Base Sepolia eip155:84532), then retry the same request with header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. (3) Or skip payment by sending X-API-Key / Authorization: Bearer (agshp_…). Discovery: GET /.well-known/x402. Pricing: GET /pricing. Marketing/docs/discovery/onboarding paths stay free (no 402).

## X402_PAY_PER_REQUEST (primary for agents)
- facilitator: Circle Gateway (batched USDC; testnet Base Sepolia eip155:84532 for pilot)
- commerce_pilot: search / offers/best ~$0.001 USDC; commerce_quote ~$0.002
- meteora_brief: dynamic $0.01–$0.30 (base $0.03; quiet market discounts; hot momentum/fee-velocity + demand surge up to 10×)
- dual_auth: valid API key skips x402; without key, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE required on gated paths
- live_price: stamped in 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED and response meta.billing.price_usd_live (dynamic endpoints)
- compact_json: REST ?format=compact / Accept: application/vnd.agentshare.compact+json; MCP prefers limit 3–5
